name: Jeannie of Biggersdale

attributes.attribute: a British spirit in Musgrave Woods who threatened travelers and cut a farmer's horse in two

sources: Briggs, Katherine M. An Encyclopedia of Fairies: Hobgoblins, Brownies, Bogies, and Other Supernatural Creatures. New York: Pantheon Books, 1976, 239.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Jeannie of Biggersdale is a British spirit. She lived in the North Riding of Yorkshire, in Musgrave Woods. Like other bogies or boggarts, she threatened passing travelers. One farmer tried to drive her out of the region. Jeannie cut his horse in two. The man was lucky to escape with his life.

okr.objective: Document Jeannie of Biggersdale as a threatening Yorkshire spirit.
key_results: Record her home in Musgrave Woods.
Note the farmer whose horse she cut in two.
